ModMetaData.name: NoMoreDevMode / Earned Resurrection
ModMetaData.author: kergunes
ModMetaData.description: Resurrection should be earned. Follow distinct, combat-focused leads, then open a guarded medical cache to recover one vanilla resurrector mech serum. Ideology encounters are preferred when available; Core encounters provide a DLC-free fallback. Configurable quest length and cooldown (default one year), one active chain. Requires Core and Harmony. V0.1: human gameplay verification pending.
